item_group.cowaxpack.title: CowaxPack
superbwarfare.page.vehicle.zenit_2c6_1: The 2C6 Zenitka is a self-propelled anti-aircraft gun system with dual 30mm cannons and ATGM capabilities. It can carry 2 crew members and provides excellent air defense.
superbwarfare.page.vehicle.zenit_2c6_2: Requires at least 4 x 3 x 3 space to place.
superbwarfare.page.vehicle.zenit_2c6_3: Basic Properties: Health - 180, Max Crew - 5, Step Height - 2.25m, Max Energy - 3,500,000FE, Energy Cost - 45FE/tick, Enclosed Vehicle (driver & commander)
superbwarfare.page.vehicle.zenit_2c6_4: Weapon Properties: Position 0: (1) Dual 30mm Cannons (4 shells per burst), Rate of Fire - 240RPM, Damage per shell - 10, Ammo - Small Shells, (2) ATGM Launcher, Rate of Fire - 200RPM, Damage - 217, Explosion Damage - 20, Explosion Radius - 2.7m, Ammo - Wire Guide Missiles. Position 1: ATGM Launcher only.
superbwarfare.page.vehicle.zenit_2c6_5: Special Features: Manual ATGM loading by right-clicking with Wire Guide Missiles, Maximum 8 ATGMs, No automatic ATGM reloading
